cards.title: Every element is a box
cards.body: `padding` is the space inside a box, around its content. `margin` is the space outside it.
cards.code: I have padding.

hi.title: Har element ek box hai
hi.body: `padding` box ke andar ki jagah hai, uske content ke aas paas. `margin` uske bahar ki jagah hai.

cards.title: Borders and corners
cards.body: `border` draws an edge, like `2px solid black`. `border-radius` rounds the corners.
cards.code: Rounded box

hi.title: Borders aur corners
hi.body: `border` ek kinara banata hai, jaise `2px solid black`. `border-radius` corners ko gol karta hai.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: The box should have a black edge, but none shows. Which line is wrong?

bug.fix: A border needs a style as well as a size and colour: `border: 2px solid black;`. Without `solid`, nothing is drawn.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Box ka kaala kinara hona chahiye, par koi nahi dikhta. Kaunsi line galat hai?
hi.fix: Border ko size aur colour ke saath ek style bhi chahiye: `border: 2px solid black;`. `solid` ke bina kuch nahi banta.

check.question: Which property adds space inside a box, around its content?
check.explanation: `padding` is inside the edge. `margin` is outside it, and `border` is the edge itself.

hi.question: Kaunsi property box ke andar, content ke aas paas jagah jodti hai?
hi.explanation: `padding` kinare ke andar hai. `margin` uske bahar hai, aur `border` khud kinara hai.

exercise.prompt: Style the `.card` box: a `padding` of `16px` and a `border-radius` of `8px`.
exercise.promptHi: `.card` box ko style karo: `16px` ki `padding` aur `8px` ka `border-radius`.
